title: I was tired of opening 2 tabs for every HN link, so I made a userscript
claim: Show HN: I was tired of opening 2 tabs for every HN link, so I made a userscript
why_good: HNewhere is a lightweight userscript that automatically detects Hacker News stories and displays comments in a sidebar, allowing seamless browsing of discussions alongside articles.
value: Content consumers, such as tech enthusiasts and researchers, pay for HNewhere to enhance their article reading with immediate access to community insights.
risk: The risk lies in the reliance on userscript managers like Tampermonkey, which may limit adoption among users unfamiliar with installing extensions.
does: HNewhere is a lightweight userscript that automatically detects Hacker News stories and displays comments in a sidebar, allowing seamless browsing of discussions alongside articles.
edge: The unique capability of HNewhere is its automatic detection of matching Hacker News stories, which eliminates the need to manually search for discussions.
why_use: Choose HNewhere for its effortless integration into your reading routine, providing instant access to relevant discussions without the hassle of switching tabs.
hook: Transform your reading experience with HNewhere: access Hacker News discussions without leaving the page.
